convert_retriever_results: convert dense retriever JSON results into serialized reader model input data files using multiprocessing
preprocess_retriever_data: preprocess retriever results into ReaderSample objects with positive and negative passages for reader training
get_best_spans: find the best answer spans from start and end logits for extractive question answering prediction
ExtractiveReaderDataset: create a PyTorch dataset that loads and optionally preprocesses reader training data from JSON or pickle files
ReaderPassage: create a ReaderPassage container to hold passage text, title, score, and answer span data for reader model input
